groups.title: Binary soldier models (infantry_ally.glb, infantry_enemy.glb) for the 3D battle; generated, not read

checks.why: [m2.render.soldier-models] loads both glb files and checks the exact clip list, the skinning and walk_speed/run_speed

risks.text: These glb files are generated by tools/blender/build_men.py and slimmed by slim_glb.py; edit the scripts and rebuild, never the glb by hand.

m2/M2_SoldierModels.js loads them by name and expects the animation names in SOLDIER_ANIMATIONS plus walk_speed/run_speed on the skeleton node; a rename or missing clip freezes soldiers or sends the battle back to box soldiers.

groups.title: Earlier project map (project-map/v1) with groups, risks and relations; a source for readfirst, not read by the game

risks.text: Its group ids and file lists predate the rewrite cleanup; check a file exists before trusting a path in it.

groups.title: Working agreement for code under src/ (state, areas, tests, style)

checks.why: the rules it describes are enforced by tests/run-all.mjs

risks.text: The first paragraph says old root game files still run and src must not depend on them; the old files are already deleted, so do not use it to judge the structure.

It says areas import each other only through index.js, but domain files import ../../game/new-game.js directly (e.g. characters/rules.js); do not treat that sentence as enforced, and expect circular-import trouble when moving shared ids out of new-game.js.

groups.title: CI workflows: test (npm test), verify (verify.mjs + 2D battle tests), m2-verify (3D checks)

risks.text: Workflows name files and scripts directly (verify.mjs, tests/run-all.mjs, 2D test files); renaming or deleting one turns CI red for a reason unrelated to the change.

groups.title: 3D battle (m2_prototype.html): simulation systems, three.js renderer, soldier animator

checks.why: includes m2 browser checks under WebGL

risks.text: The renderer's SoldierAnimator picks each loadout's clips from LOADOUT_CLIPS in M2_RendererThree.js; SOLDIER_ANIMATIONS in M2_SoldierModels.js is only the list the loader requires. Using a new clip needs LOADOUT_CLIPS; renaming or removing a listed clip makes loading throw and the battle falls back to box soldiers.
m2_verify.mjs checks are listed in tests/checks.json by legacyId; adding or removing a check there without updating the list fails npm test.
If the glb models fail to load, the battle starts anyway with simple box soldiers (M2_SoldierModels.js header); a missing or renamed model file shows up as boxes, not an error.

Each soldier is about 16,200 triangles near the camera and about 2,100 beyond FAR_MODEL_DISTANCE (the soldier_far level of detail); many near soldiers cost triangles and draw calls on phones. Compare the diagnostics' triangles and drawCalls before adding soldiers or detail; lowering FAR_MODEL_DISTANCE shows near soldiers simplified.

m2UnitKindForFormation strips a trailing _<number> from the formation id before looking up its kind ("ally_loose_2" is crossbow like "ally_loose"). Large-battle formation ids must keep a base id from the kind table plus _N; a new formation name that ends in digits silently gets the base name's kind, or infantry if the base is unknown.

buildScaleSnapshot lays out a fixed field for 20 to 100 a side; the lines are placed so everyone stands inside the 18 m retreat edge. More than 100 a side would start men past the edges, so m2_prototype.html?scale=N ignores values outside 20 to 100 and opens the normal 20-a-side fixture. The 100-a-side battle measured about 690–790 draw calls and 0.8–1.2 million triangles (software rendering), because every soldier is drawn separately.

groups.title: Entry pages (index.html game, m2_prototype.html 3D battle, battle2d.html dev page), static verify scripts, package and Playwright config

checks.why: index.html scripts and every src module parse and import existing files

risks.text: index.html loads only src/main.js and src/ui/ui.css; changing those paths blanks the whole game.
playwright.config.mjs gives the 3D tests SwiftShader but must not give it to the 2D tests; with it 2D canvas runs about 7fps and time-based checks fail.
README says run through an HTTP server (node tests/support/static-server.mjs .), not file://, because pages load ES modules.

groups.title: Composition root: main.js picks browser storage and the battle starter and passes them to mountApp

checks.why: ui-map browser check boots the app

risks.text: main.js is the only place that knows the browser; the arguments it passes to mountApp (storage, startBattle, world) are what src/ui expects, and changing either side blanks the screen.

groups.title: 2D battle: seeded simulation in sim/, canvas, HUD and input in ui/

checks.why: sim, battle and ui-battle unit tests

risks.text: A unit that is dead (hp<=0) must not strike; engine.js guards both sides before each strike, and an old bug let a fallen soldier hit in the same tick.
Randomness comes only from the seeded generator (sim/random.js, src/core/rng.js); Math.random makes the same seed give different battles.
session.js delivers the result through onEnd exactly once and nothing runs after dispose(); the simulation never writes saves.

groups.title: Game state store, calendar, seeded rng, ids, result helpers

risks.text: store.transact discards the whole draft on a returned failure, a throw, non-JSON data or failed validation; rules rely on this and carry no undo code.
State must stay plain JSON (no Map, Set, Date, class); the store rejects it with store_state_not_json.

groups.title: Game areas (world, settlements, characters, groups, control, finance, inventory, politics, relations, memories, followups, definitions), each with rules, checks and index

risks.text: Rules mutate a draft and return fail(...) to abort; a rule that fails after partly changing must not be wrapped to swallow the failure or the half change is kept.
Settlement construction and stock costs must be paid in full or not at all, and refunds checked before any change.
The world record shapes match the v1 save; changing a field needs a conversion step in src/persist/migrate-v1.js in the same change.
Each area registers its checks with registerAreaCheck from its index.js; a new area or checks file not registered is never validated on load.
dailySteps run in order across all areas and one failing step fails the whole day; give new steps an unused order number.

groups.title: Game flow: new-game state shape, daily runner, campaign open/advance/save

risks.text: runDueDays runs each ended day as one transaction; if a step fails that day and later days stay unprocessed. Do not catch the failure and advance the date.
Changing the state shape in new-game.js makes existing saves fail validation; add a conversion step in src/persist in the same change.
The advance-time path in campaign.js is the only place screens move the calendar (store.transact 'advance time'); the days it ends are then run by daily.js, so keep both steps in order.

groups.title: Save, load and convert the earlier ars_bellum_save_v1 into v2

checks.why: save, staging and v1 conversion checks

risks.text: ars_bellum_save_v1 is only read and converted, never written or removed; players of the earlier version keep it.
save writes a staging key, reads it back, then writes the real key and restores the old contents on failure; keep that order and the revision checks (save_conflict, older-than-stored).
An unreadable stored save is kept and saving is refused unless replaceUnreadable is passed, so a damaged save is not lost silently.
migrate-v1 is tested against a real old save, tests/fixtures/v1-new-game-save.json; do not replace the fixture with a hand-made one.

groups.title: Screens: menu, world map, settlement panel, battle flow and result

risks.text: A practice battle result must not reach campaign; battle-result.js and app.js treat mode 'practice' as record-nothing (an old bug recorded loot and settlements).

Battle victory is recorded in one store.transact('battle victory') in battle-result.js and then saved; if the save fails it is undone. Keep gold, manpower and territory in that single transaction, and add new state changes to campaign.js or that file rather than scattering transact calls across screens.
The ?fakeBattle= query in main.js drives a stand-in battle for browser tests; keep its end types and the double-report option working.

groups.title: Unit, browser and support code; checks.json is the one list of required checks, run-all.mjs runs them

risks.text: Every test title must start with its [check id] and the id must be in tests/checks.json; an untagged, unlisted or result-less id fails npm test, and deleting a list entry silently drops a check.
Not-run browser checks must stay NOT_TESTED with a reason, never PASS; set PW_CHROMIUM_PATH to use a local Chromium.
Break the code a new test guards once and see it fail; a failed rule must be asserted to change nothing.

groups.title: Blender scripts that build the 3D soldier glb files (offline, not part of npm test)

checks.why: with Blender's bpy module: check_soldier.py checks every frame of every clip and slim_glb.py checks the slimmed animations; any problem stops the glb being written
[m2.render.soldier-models] checks the glb files the build wrote

risks.text: build_men.py refuses to write a glb when check_soldier.py finds clipping, floating, gaps or joint-limit problems, and slim_glb.py overwrites only if all animations match within 1e-6; do not bypass these.

MakeHuman data is downloaded from extensions.blender.org and checked by SHA-256; that link has returned 404 since 2026-10-31, so the build falls back to the repository branch ccr-3692cb93-6pjzuu-mpfb, which must not be deleted.
Hard-coded part positions break when body or clothes change (knees, ears, shield, belt); position parts from the body's own points.

m2_scale_bench.mjs re-runs M2BattleRuntime's fixed-tick systems in a hand-copied order, timing each phase. If the runtime's tick gains, drops or reorders a system, the bench no longer measures the real tick until it is updated. It writes to test-results/ by default and is not part of npm test; m2_scale_render.mjs needs Playwright Chromium and draws in software (SwiftShader) when there is no GPU.

groups.title: Pinned three.js r184 (0.184.0) with GLTFLoader and utilities, used by the 3D battle without network import

risks.text: Version is pinned and the change needs the owner's approval; MANIFEST.json records files and sizes, and m2_prototype.html import map points three to the same file.

rules.rule: Game state changes only inside store.transact; a failure or throw discards the whole draft.
rules.why: Rules need no undo code and saves stay consistent.

rules.rule: Rules use draw(draft.rng) and draft.calendar, never Math.random or Date.now.
rules.why: The same save or seed must give the same result; the battle2d test proves it for the simulation, domain rules are by convention (docs/REWRITE.md).

rules.rule: State holds plain JSON only: no Map, Set, Date or class instances.
rules.why: Saving and the store's JSON check depend on it.

rules.rule: A stored record shape changes only together with a src/persist step that converts old saves.
ars_bellum_save_v1 is read and converted but never changed or deleted.
rules.why: Players of the earlier version keep their save.

rules.rule: A day is processed by every step in order or not at all; a failing step leaves it and later days unprocessed.
rules.why: Dates must not advance without settlement calculations.

rules.rule: A practice battle never changes the saved game.
rules.why: An old bug recorded loot and settlements from practice wins.

rules.rule: Every check id in a test title is listed in tests/checks.json and every listed id gets a result.
A 2D battle reports its result through onEnd exactly once and never after dispose().
rules.why: A second report would record a victory twice.

rules.rule: save() refuses to overwrite a stored save that is unreadable (unless replaceUnreadable) or from a newer version, or whose revision differs from the one loaded.
rules.why: A damaged or newer save must not be lost silently.
